{{Quote|Luck has nothing to do with it.|Tee Va|<ref name="Corruption" />}}
'''Tee Va''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who smuggled [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|tea]] into the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
===Dealings on Mandalore===
Because of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] neutrality, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was cut off from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and had to call on [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] for supplies, a call that Tee Va accepted.<ref name="Corruption" />

He and his subordinates smuggled various goods to the planet, easily bribing corrupt customs officials, police and various other people in order to move about freely with his business. Among the goods Tee Va provided was [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|Ardees Beverage tea]]. He added [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]] to the tea to dilute it in order to make twice as much of it, and thus make twice the profit. However, this made the drinks poisonous and many children fell ill from drinking the tea. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and the [[Duchess of Mandalore]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] tracked Tee Va and his minions to the docks and put down his operation. After a firefight, he and several accomplices were taken into custody.<ref name="Corruption" />

===Zygerria===
Later in the War, Tee Va was still active and free of Mandalorian custody. He eventually found his way to [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] and checked out what the [[Zygerrian slave market/Legends|Zygerrian slave market]] offered in terms of slaves. After that he participated in the Slave Auction held by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]] where he stood on a balcony with [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] [[Junior Representative/Legends|representative]] [[Nix Card/Legends|Nix Card]].<ref name="SotR">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref>

===Return to Mandalore===
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date Legends">{{TCWdates|516}}</ref> Va returned to Mandalore, now under the control of the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], to continue smuggling, ordering other Moogans to move crates as [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Twilight/Legends|Twilight]]''. Va briefly looked over when there was scuffling aboard the freighter, but quickly turned back and continued to move the shipping containers.<ref name="The Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Tee Va was a Moogan male smuggler, had [[Color|yellow]] [[eye]]s and green skin. Va desired increased profits and therefore he sold contraband goods on Mandalore. His sly tactics enabled him to dilute tea with high levels of slabin.<ref name="Corruption" />

==Equipment==
Tee Va utilized a [[Weequay blaster pistol/Legends|Weequay blaster pistol]] in combat.<ref name="Corruption" /> Va's clothing included a golden metallic headdress.<ref name="Corruption Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode305.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Corruption}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tee Va was voiced by actor [[Dee Bradley Baker]],<ref name="Corruption Ep Guide" /> who also voices the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the series.<ref name="The Clone Wars">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>
